Granite.description: Embedded within the flesh of the bearer, the Granite component manifests as a dense, semi-translucent lattice of mineral fibers that intertwine with the host's circulatory system, granting an impenetrable shield of natural armor that hardens their skin and fortifies their defenses against physical attacks.

Sandstone.description: Embedded within the rugged exoskeleton of the entity, the Sandstone component manifests as a layer of hardened earth and minerals, granting it an additional layer of resilience and a defensive boost that deflects blows with the tenacity of ancient, unyielding desert cliffs.
